name: microservices-demo
description: Simulação de Arquitetura de Microserviços - Usuários, Produtos, Pedidos e Pagamentos

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api-gateway && npm install && cd ../services/user-service && npm install && cd ../product-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../payment-service && npm install && cd ../../..
scripts.start: concurrently --names "GATEWAY,USERS,PRODUCTS,ORDERS,PAYMENTS" --prefix-colors "bgBlue,bgGreen,bgYellow,bgRed,bgMagenta" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:users" "npm run start:products" "npm run start:orders" "npm run start:payments"
